name: Majik
summary: “Majik” tells the story of King Markham, who, on his deathbed, desperately hopes to see his only son and heir, Prince Gideon, one last time. Rumors claim that Gideon is being held captive by the sinister Domir, as he alone can unite the Clans of the Reaches and thwart Domir's reign. The wizard Piradon is tasked with rescuing the prince, but his magical powers are limited in the dangerous lands he must traverse. The game is a first-person adventure where players progress by completing tasks.
